message.content:
In this repository (/bench/repo), there is a concept of a "memo" (or "note"/"entry") that carries derived metadata computed from its content rather than set by the user — used for lists/previews (like a preview text, title, word count, etc.).

Find:
1. WHERE this derived metadata is computed (exact file path and function/line).
2. WHICH operations trigger recomputation (e.g. on create, on update/edit, on save).
3. WHAT the computation extracts (which properties — e.g. title, preview, word count, etc.).

Search for terms like "memo", "note", "preview", "metadata", "derive", "excerpt", "snippet", "wordCount", "title". Report exact file paths and line numbers, and quote the relevant code. Be thorough — look at model/schema files, service layers, and any place where content is parsed.

I have a complete picture. Here are my findings.

## Summary

This is the **Memos** project (usememos). A "memo" carries two tiers of derived metadata computed from its Markdown content, both produced by a goldmark-based markdown service in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

---

### 1. WHERE it is computed

**Tier A — Persisted metadata (stored on the memo's `Payload`)**

- Entry point: `RebuildMemoPayload` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`. It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(...)` and assigns the results:
  ```go
  data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
  ...
  memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
  memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
  ```
- The actual extraction logic: `service.ExtractAll` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422` (single AST walk). A separate, equivalent `ExtractProperties` also exists at `markdown.go:193-241`.
- The H1-title helper: `extractHeadingText` at `markdown.go:172-179`, invoked at `markdown.go:386-388` (and `211` in `ExtractProperties`).

**Tier B — Snippet / preview text (computed on-the-fly, NOT persisted)**

- `GenerateSnippet` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:264-346` (with `truncateAtWord` at `markdown.go:472-489`).
- Wrapped by `getMemoContentSnippet` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`, which hard-codes a 64-character max:
  ```go
  snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
  ```

---

### 2. WHICH operations trigger recomputation

**Persisted Payload (`RebuildMemoPayload`) is triggered on:**
- **Create memo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (in `CreateMemo`).
- **Update memo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, but *only* when the `content` field is in the update mask (guarded by `if path == "content"` at line 436). It then sets `update.Payload = memo.Payload` (line 451). Editing only visibility/pinned/state does not recompute.
- **Bulk backfill/migration** — `Runner.RunOnce` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` rebuilds the payload of *all* memos in batches of 100.

**Snippet (Tier B) is computed at read/serialization time**, every time a memo is converted to an API response — it is never stored:
- `convertMemoFromStore` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80`.
- Batched list conversion — `memo_service_converter.go:221-273`.
- Memo relations — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:154-173`.
- Notifications — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-391`.

---

### 3. WHAT the computation extracts

**Persisted `MemoPayload` fields** (schema at `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto:7-29`):
- `tags` — deduplicated list of `#tags` (case preserved), skipping tags inside links/images (`markdown.go:376-378`, dedup at `418`).
- `property.title` (field 5) — plain text of the first H1 heading, only if it is the document's first block-level child (`markdown.go:384-389`).
- `property.has_link` (field 1) — true if any link node exists (`markdown.go:393-394`).
- `property.has_code` (field 3) — true for any code block, fenced code block, or inline code span (`markdown.go:396-397`).
- `property.has_task_list` (field 2) — true if any task checkbox exists (`markdown.go:399-400`).
- `property.has_incomplete_tasks` (field 4) — true if any task checkbox is unchecked (`markdown.go:401-405`).
- (`ExtractAll` also collects `Mentions` — lowercased `@usernames` — into its return struct, but `RebuildMemoPayload` does not persist them into the payload.)

**Snippet/preview** (`GenerateSnippet`, `markdown.go:264-346`): a plain-text summary that walks the AST extracting text, skips fenced/indented code blocks (but keeps inline code), inserts spaces between block elements, renders tags as `#tag` and autolinks as their URL, then truncates at a word boundary (max 64 runes) appending `" ..."`.

---

### Note on "word count"
There is **no word-count** computed in the Go backend — the persisted derived metadata is title/tags/booleans, and the runtime preview is the snippet. `wordCount` only appears in the web frontend (e.g. under `web/src/...`), separate from this backend metadata pipeline. If a word-count field is what you're after, it is a frontend-only computation, not part of the memo `Payload`.

Key files:
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (all extraction logic)
- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`RebuildMemoPayload`)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (create/update triggers)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (`getMemoContentSnippet`, 64-char)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (snippet applied at response time)
- `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` (persisted schema)
